text:
Rina: Morning mystery: my stapler has a tiny knight helmet sticker on it. Who knighted the stapler? :helmet_with_cross:
Tom: that was me. It defended my TPS report during a paper avalanche. Best office defense item. :crossed_swords:
Doorman Dan: I hereby recognize Stapler Knight as an honorary guardian. New protocol: if you borrow Stapler Knight, leave a thank-you note and a granola token.
Harper: can we have an oath? I demand ceremony. Also we should make a tiny crest.
Jules: ops-bot make a quick poll: Office Mascot? Stapler Knight / Captain Prickles / Fern Ambassador. Low-effort. :robot_face:
ops-bot: Poll created: "Office Mascot pick" Options: Stapler Knight / Captain Prickles / Fern Ambassador. React to vote.
Rina: voted Stapler Knight. :white_check_mark:
Tom: voted Stapler Knight (obviously). :crossed_swords:
Harper: voted Captain Prickles (plant solidarity). :seedling:
Doorman Dan: voted Stapler Knight. Also proposing the Stapler Oath:
```
Stapler Knight Oath v0.9
- I shall not jam on purpose.
- I shall return thee unto thy desk within one business hour.
- I shall defend documents and small paper creatures.
- Granola tokens accepted as tribute.
```
Jules: love it. We should laminate a miniature oath card and tape it under the stapler. Rituals increase retention.
Rina: can someone design a tiny crest? I vote for a stapler crossed with a tiny cactus (for solidarity).
Tom: I will draw a 5-minute sketch and stick it on the desk. Low-effort crest.
Harper: also adding clause: any midnight stapling requires a solemn bow and a haiku. I'm not kidding.
Doorman Dan: midnight clause enforced. Donuts for haiku offenders.
Jules: ops-bot, reminder: close poll in 24h and post results in #random. Also create onboarding snippet: "How to petition for office honors (stapler knighting, plant coronations, bell custody)."
ops-bot: Poll closing reminder scheduled: "Office Mascot pick closes in 24h". Onboarding card draft task created. :bell:
Rina: ok Stapler Knight is now a living legend. Adding photo to #random-photos. https://files.redwood/stapler_knight.jpg
Tom: will bring two mini stickers for the crest tomorrow. First come first knighted.
Harper: I will compose a haiku in honor of the Stapler Knight: "Metal jaw clamps life / Pages breathe, bound in quiet / Hero on the desk."
Doorman Dan: judged. Haiku earns one granola token. Ceremony scheduled when the crest is laminated.
Jules: already envisioning a tiny embroidered patch. low-cost morale boost incoming. :sparkles:
ops-bot: Poll closed. Results: Stapler Knight 4 votes, Captain Prickles 1 vote, Fern Ambassador 1 vote. Stapler Knight elected. Posting to #random. :tada:
